facts.text: Melanie and her family went camping on 19 October 2023, which was a way to relax after a road trip.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Caroline! Yup, we just did it yesterday! The kids loved it and it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.
I love camping trips with my fam, 'cause nature brings such peace and serenity.

facts.text: Melanie finds camping with her family to be a way to reset and recharge, as it brings peace and serenity.

evidence.quote: It really helps me reset and recharge. I love camping trips with my fam, 'cause nature brings such peace and serenity.
It's so peaceful waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air - it always refreshes my soul.

facts.text: Melanie and her family enjoy bonding over stories, campfires, and nature during their camping trips.

evidence.quote: We bond over stories, campfires and nature.
